dogecoin.text: By enabling developers to create consumer apps in gaming, DeFi, and AI. The funds will support platform launch, developer tools, and partnerships to drive adoption, enhancing Dogecoin’s utility for its 10 million+ holders. https://t.co/uTs2hrlnUe

DogeOS, an application layer for the Dogecoin ecosystem, raised $6.9 million in a funding round led by Polychain Capital on May 6, 2025. Built by the MyDoge team, it aims to transform Dogecoin from a memecoin into a robust platform.
